name: bag-setup
eval: window.G=__grahan.game; window.A=__grahan; A.set('hazards',false); A.step(0.2); ({bag:A.state().backpack, rupees:G.wallet.rupees, touch:A.state().touch})

name: bag-phone-water-biscuit
eval: const r=[A.do('bagUse','phone','time'), A.do('bagUse','water','sip'), A.do('bagUse','biscuits','eat'), A.do('bagUse','item:pills','feel')]; ({r, s:A.state().backpack, decayMul:A.state().health.decayMul})

name: bag-full-rays-refuses
eval: A.set('rays',12); const before=A.state().backpack.dshots; const r=A.do('bagUse','dshots','jab'); ({r, before, after:A.state().backpack.dshots})

name: vendor-cash
eval: A.set('rays',4); const v=G.vendors.active[0]; A.do('vendorRoll', v.id, {potency:3, risk:0}); const t0=G.clock.t; A.do('vendorOpen', v.id); const d=A.state().dialog; ({dialog:d, rupees:G.wallet.rupees, t0})

name: vendor-cash-paid
eval: const t0=G.clock.t; A.do('dialogChoose','cash'); A.step(2); ({rupees:G.wallet.rupees, rays:G.player.rays, clockMoved:+(G.clock.t-t0).toFixed(3), stats:A.state().vendors.stats})
